name: LexMom Launch — five-email introduction
audience: Sourced law-firm contacts with verified relevance to Launch. Named contacts and firm inboxes receive distinct subject context.

steps.subject: An AI website from one practice brief?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, a website from one practice brief?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: an AI website from a short brief?
steps.topic: From practice brief to website draft
steps.body:
Could an AI-drafted website be useful for {firm_name}?

LexMom Launch turns a short practice brief into website pages and client intake for your team to review.

Which practice area would you want to show first?
steps.body_firm:
Who handles {firm_name}’s website and client intake?

LexMom Launch drafts website pages from a short practice brief, with your team reviewing the content.

Could you point us to the right colleague?
steps.new_information: Introduces the brief-to-website workflow and asks for a relevant practice area.

steps.subject: What would your first practice page say?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, which practice page should we start with?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: what should the first practice page say?
steps.body:
In our last email, we introduced LexMom Launch for {firm_name}.

A useful starting point is one practice page: who you help, the services you offer and how clients contact you. Launch drafts it from your brief.

Which practice area would you want to explore first?
steps.new_information: Adds a concrete evaluation scope: one practice page and its client-contact path.

steps.subject: AI drafts. Your firm decides.
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, AI drafts—the final say stays with your firm
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: review the AI draft before publishing
steps.body:
Our last note suggested starting with one practice page.

With Launch, your team reviews the AI-drafted pages and intake before publishing. A short walkthrough can show those steps for {firm_name}.

Would you like to see that draft-and-review flow?
steps.new_information: Explains the human review step before publication and offers a walkthrough.

steps.subject: Which part of Launch should we explain?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: which part of Launch should we explain?
steps.body:
Last time, we offered a walkthrough of Launch’s draft-and-review flow for {firm_name}.

We can focus it on website content or client intake, depending on what you want to evaluate.

Which part would make the walkthrough useful to you?
steps.new_information: Narrows the walkthrough to the recipient’s actual content or intake question.

steps.subject: Should we close this website conversation?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, should we close this website conversation?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: final feedback on the website idea
steps.body:
Our last email asked which part of Launch would be useful for {firm_name}.

This is our final follow-up. Was the website idea relevant, not for now or outside your priorities?

A short reply would help us improve our approach. Thank you.
steps.new_information: Requests relevance/timing feedback and closes the sequence without pressure.

name: LexMom Manage — five-email introduction
audience: Sourced law-firm contacts with verified relevance to Manage. Questions do not assume the firm uses outdated tools.

steps.subject: One matter. A clearer view.
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, one place to follow a matter?
steps.body:
Would one view of clients, tasks, documents and financial context be useful for {firm_name}?

LexMom Manage connects practice workflows with AI-assisted features. A short demo lets you judge the fit.

Which workflow would you want to see?
steps.body_firm:
Who looks after matter workflows at {firm_name}?

LexMom Manage connects client, task, document and financial context with AI-assisted features.

Could you direct us to the colleague who evaluates practice-management tools?
steps.new_information: Introduces connected matter workflows and asks which process matters to the firm.

steps.subject: Tasks, documents or billing—which first?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: which matter workflow should come first?
steps.body:
In our last email, we introduced LexMom Manage for {firm_name}.

You can evaluate it through one workflow—tasks, documents or billing—using a typical matter. That keeps the walkthrough focused on your work.

Which workflow would you choose?
steps.new_information: Offers a focused evaluation through one workflow and a typical matter.

steps.subject: See one matter, then judge the fit
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: see one matter, then judge the fit
steps.body:
Our last note asked which workflow you would evaluate first.

In a Manage demo, we can follow one matter from client context through tasks, documents and financial information for {firm_name}.

Which process should we focus on? You can choose a demo time below.
steps.new_information: Explains what the matter walkthrough can demonstrate and provides a demo route.

steps.subject: What would make a Manage demo worthwhile?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, what would make a Manage demo worthwhile?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: what should a Manage demo answer?
steps.body:
Last time, we offered a one-matter walkthrough of Manage for {firm_name}.

We can tailor that conversation around setup, workflow fit or how your team would use it.

What would you need the demo to answer?
steps.new_information: Focuses the demo on a specific setup, fit or team-use question.

steps.subject: Should we close this Manage conversation?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, should we close this Manage conversation?
steps.body:
Our last email asked what a Manage demo should answer for {firm_name}.

This is our final follow-up. Is practice management a priority, a later conversation or not relevant?

A short reply would help us improve our approach. Thank you.
steps.new_information: Requests priority/timing feedback and ends acquisition follow-ups.

name: LexMom Launch + Manage — five-email introduction
audience: Sourced contacts with evidence of relevance to both products. One sequence; product preference narrows later messages.
secondary_cta_label: Explore LexMom Manage / Book a LexMom Manage demo

steps.subject: Two LexMom tools. One firm priority.
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, what should LexMom help with first?
steps.body:
For {firm_name}, which would be more useful now: an AI-assisted website or a clearer matter workflow?

LexMom Launch drafts website pages and intake. LexMom Manage connects client, task, document and financial context.

Which product would you like to explore first?
steps.body_firm:
Who at {firm_name} evaluates the website and practice operations?

LexMom Launch supports AI-drafted pages and intake. LexMom Manage connects matter workflows.

Could you direct us to the right colleague and their current priority?
steps.new_information: Introduces both products and asks which priority should lead the conversation.

steps.subject: A website draft—or a matter walkthrough?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, a website draft or a matter walkthrough?
steps.subject_firm: {firm_name}: website draft or matter walkthrough first?
steps.body:
In our last email, we introduced LexMom Launch and Manage for {firm_name}.

A focused starting point could be one practice page in Launch or one matter workflow in Manage. You can assess the product against your work.

Which would be more useful to explore first?
steps.new_information: Adds two concrete evaluation starting points without creating parallel sequences.

steps.subject: Two ways to see LexMom before deciding
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, which LexMom flow should we show?
steps.body:
Our last note offered a practice-page or matter-workflow starting point.

For {firm_name}, we can show Launch’s brief, draft and review steps, or follow one matter through Manage. A walkthrough lets you inspect the flow.

Which would you like to see?
steps.new_information: Explains the actual walkthrough for either product; does not assume a preference.

steps.subject: Fit, setup or timing—which should we explain?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, what would make a LexMom walkthrough useful?
steps.body:
Last time, we offered a Launch or Manage walkthrough for {firm_name}.

We can focus it on the question that matters most: product fit, setup or timing. If both products matter, we can start with your first priority.

What should we clarify?
steps.new_information: Tailors the next discussion to the recipient’s actual question or first priority.

steps.subject: Launch, Manage—or should we stop here?
steps.subject_named: {contact_name}, Launch, Manage—or should we stop here?
steps.body:
Our last email asked what a LexMom walkthrough should clarify for {firm_name}.

This is our final follow-up. Which fits your priorities: Launch, Manage, both, not now or not relevant?

A short reply would help us improve our approach. Thank you.
steps.new_information: Asks for product/relevance feedback and closes the single combined sequence.
